message.content:
The capital of Australia is **Canberra**. 

It's a common misconception that Sydney or Melbourne is the capital — Canberra was actually purpose-built as the capital in the early 20th century as a compromise between those two rival cities. It's located in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT), about 280 km southwest of Sydney.
